name: @loomwork/experience-broadcast
description: loom-ui audience for anyone: ONE support-desk Experience rendered twice - a personal surface for the agent who asked (their clearance decides) and a broadcast wallboard on the lobby screen (the lowest-class ceiling applies, whoever is logged in). compile({ audience: 'broadcast' }) turns every classified widget into loom's redacted widget; the hydration inventory and server refuse the same handles, so the wallboard's browser never even asks for them; the renderers draw only a constant marker.
